# Remaining runtime correspondence for #195

Exact owner #186 cohort: 13 Profiler and seven transport URIs, excluding the ten
already published under `runtime-read-log-195-r1`, all Topics and SoundEngine.
The ten pinned catalogs yield 72 public version routes, 144 native host/build
routes and 5,996 exact field/option/enum/presence/default/result members.
`source-roster.json` seals those independent sources; reference occurrences are
mapped separately without discarding shared paths.

The actual product omission was the getMeters root whitelist. It rejected 11
pinned declared return spellings in 2024.1, 13 in 2025.1, and three existing
namespaced source business outputs in both. The existing fixed query vocabulary
and projection are reused. Declared spellings preserve all returned extra keys,
nulls, empty values and missing identity without claiming aliases, semantic
population or mutation authority. Unknown selectors still reject. The documented
capture-data omitted-true default already had an explicit equivalent enable
choice; it is mapped as normalization without changing public syntax. The
accepted 2023.1 useOriginals explicit-choice boundary stays intact.

`map_runtime_remaining_completion.py` writes ordinary mapping attachments,
requirements parts and original aggregate CODE attachments. Program sibling
support never fabricates per-node receipts or native observations. The exact
legacy native policies remain: a source-backed same-route resultSchema root is
still required by the existing consumer. This component therefore reports
`implemented_unverified` where Main has yet to join native evidence; it does not
claim global or whole-runtime acceptance. `selected-proof-plan.json` gives the
finite per-URI gap/accounting and gate reconciliation proposal.

The canonical product index had no bindings for these 20 URIs. Existing reviewed
support files retain 133 exact host/build profiles: capture 30, cursor ten,
transport 64, diagnostic readers 18, owned controls nine and meter frames two.
The nine owned-control Console slots and two meter Console slots have no profile;
this is an observation distinction, not eleven mandatory new tests or proof of
missing functions. ACK-only, opaque SDK, artifact-format, resource ownership and
original FAIL/BLOCKED limits remain unchanged. `accepted-history.json` retains
source and archive seals without upgrading their verdicts.

Two existing portable closures are imported unchanged, rather than regenerated:
`retained-transport-r133/index.json` has 14 native roots / 42 mappings from the
reviewed 2024 paired-host packet; `retained-meter-r137/index.json` has one retained
2025 Authoring meter root / three mappings. Each directory preserves the original
index, exact selected descriptor subset, all recursively referenced original
bytes, source/candidate attribution and an import review. They are historical
ordinary-reader inputs; current source-equivalence admission remains Main's join.
No native workflow was run and the old source maps or outcomes were not rewritten.

The new meter choices have conditional Gateway CODE proof only. Prior native
`states`/`suppportsRandomizer` empty-object observations remain anomalous
responses, with no alias, identity or data-population claim. Host-specific native
effect facts may only be reused in their actual recorded scope.
